object_types.name: FinancialProduct
object_types.description: A non-deposit financial product issued by a bank or its subsidiary, with associated risks and potential returns.

properties.name: product_name
properties.description: The name of the financial product.

properties.name: product_code
properties.description: The unique code assigned to the financial product by the issuing institution.

properties.name: registration_code
properties.description: The registration code of the financial product in the national banking financial information registration system.

properties.name: risk_rating
properties.description: The risk rating assigned to the financial product, indicating its level of risk.

properties.name: term_in_days
properties.description: The term of the financial product in days.

properties.name: maturity_date
properties.description: The maturity date of the financial product.

properties.name: productName
properties.description: 产品名称

properties.name: registrationCode
properties.description: 理财产品登记编码

properties.name: productCode
properties.description: 产品代码

properties.name: productType
properties.description: 产品类型（公募、固定收益类、封闭式）

properties.name: riskLevel
properties.description: 信银理财产品风险分级（如PR2级）

object_types.name: RiskType
object_types.description: A type of risk associated with a financial product.

properties.name: risk_name
properties.description: The name or description of the risk type.

properties.name: risk_description
properties.description: A detailed description of the risk type and its potential impact on the financial product.

object_types.name: Investor
object_types.description: An individual or entity that invests in a financial product.

properties.name: investor_id
properties.description: A unique identifier for the investor.

properties.name: investor_type
properties.description: The type of investor, either 'individual' or 'institution'.

properties.name: risk_tolerance
properties.description: An assessment of the investor's ability to bear investment risks.

properties.name: investorId
properties.description: 投资者唯一标识

properties.name: investorType
properties.description: 投资者类型（个人/机构）

properties.name: riskProfile
properties.description: 投资风险承受能力评估结果

object_types.name: SalesChannel
object_types.description: 销售渠道：包括信银理财电子渠道、直销渠道以及合作销售机构。

properties.name: channelId
properties.description: 渠道唯一标识

properties.name: channelType
properties.description: 渠道类型（电子/直销/代销）

object_types.name: InvestmentAsset
object_types.description: 投资标的：包括债权类、权益类、商品及金融衍生品类等。

properties.name: assetId
properties.description: 投资标的唯一标识

properties.name: assetType
properties.description: 资产类型（债权/权益/商品衍生品）

properties.name: valuation
properties.description: 当前估值

object_types.name: InvestmentContract
object_types.description: 理财产品合同：包括说明书、风险揭示书和投资协议等。

properties.name: contractId
properties.description: 合同唯一标识

properties.name: productName
properties.description: 关联产品名称

properties.name: version
properties.description: 合同版本号

object_types.name: FundProduct
object_types.description: 信银理财产品基本信息及属性

properties.name: productName
properties.description: 产品名称

properties.name: registrationCode
properties.description: 理财产品登记编码

properties.name: productCode
properties.description: 产品代码

properties.name: productType
properties.description: 产品类型（公募、固定收益类、封闭式）

properties.name: riskLevel
properties.description: 信银理财产品风险分级（PR2，稳健型）

properties.name: targetInvestors
properties.description: 发行对象及适合投资者类型

properties.name: shareTypes
properties.description: 理财产品份额类型列表

properties.name: fundraisingPeriodStart
properties.description: 募集期开始日期

properties.name: fundraisingPeriodEnd
properties.description: 募集期结束日期

properties.name: operationStartDate
properties.description: 运作起始日

properties.name: buildupPeriodStart
properties.description: 产品建仓期开始日期

properties.name: buildupPeriodEnd
properties.description: 产品建仓期结束日期

properties.name: maturityDate
properties.description: 到期日

properties.name: clearingPeriodStart
properties.description: 清算期开始日期（等同于到期日）

properties.name: minimumFundraisingAmount
properties.description: 计划募集金额下限（人民币500万元）

properties.name: currency
properties.description: 投资与收益币种（人民币）

object_types.name: ShareType
object_types.description: 理财产品份额类型及其属性

properties.name: shareTypeName
properties.description: 份额类型名称（如A、D等）

properties.name: shareCode
properties.description: 份额代码

properties.name: performanceBenchmarkRange
properties.description: 业绩比较基准范围（如2.30%-3.00%）

link_types.name: hasRisk
link_types.description: Links a financial product to its associated risk types.

link_types.name: investsIn
link_types.description: Links an investor to the financial products they have invested in.

link_types.name: InvestsIn
link_types.description: 投资关系：表示投资者购买了某个理财产品。

link_types.name: SellsThrough
link_types.description: 销售渠道关联：表示某个理财产品通过哪些销售渠道进行销售。

link_types.name: HoldsAsset
link_types.description: 持仓关系：表示某个理财产品持有的投资标的。

link_types.name: GovernedByContract
link_types.description: 合同约束：表示理财产品受哪些合同约束。

link_types.name: ProductShareTypeLink
link_types.description: FundProduct与ShareType之间的关联，表示产品包含哪些份额类型

action_types.name: purchase
action_types.description: An action where an investor purchases a financial product.

action_types.name: redeem
action_types.description: An action where an investor redeems their investment in a financial product.

action_types.name: PurchaseProduct
action_types.description: 购买理财产品：投资者通过某个渠道购买指定的理财产品。

action_types.name: RedeemProduct
action_types.description: 赎回理财产品：投资者提前赎回已购买的理财产品。

action_types.name: AdjustAssetAllocation
action_types.description: 调整资产配置：理财产品管理人根据市场情况调整投资标的比例。

action_types.name: UpdateFundraisingPeriod
action_types.description: 更新募集期起始和结束日期的操作
